name: cmdb_import_audit
label: Batch Import Audit Table in CMDB
description: CMDB batch import for audit tables can be used for status tracking and query related to configuration management, including reporting scenarios.

fields.name: id
fields.description: ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: import_date
fields.description: Import time. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: action
fields.description: Append: incremental import; update: bulk import; all: full import.

fields.name: file_id
fields.description: Import the ID of the attached file.

fields.name: ci_id
fields.description: Retrieve the ID from the cmdb_ci table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_import_date
indexes.description: Standard index covering the import_date field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
